story: I'm an aspiring programmer passionate about building fast, user-friendly applications. My journey in software development has been driven by a love for solving real-world problems through code.

I've gained hands-on experience through internships at MediBuddy, Supernest.ai, and Schaffen Softwares, where I've worked on both web and mobile applications. At MediBuddy, I migrated Angular modules to Next.js, improved accessibility scores, and optimized Core Web Vitals significantly.

I've also built and published mobile apps on the Play Store, including a finance module for Supernest.ai and messaging features for Blox. My hackathon project, an AI-powered Personalized Learning System, secured 3rd place at VEDHA Hackathon.
Currently pursuing B.E. in Computer Science and Business Systems at JSS Science and Technology University, I'm always eager to learn new technologies and take on challenging projects.
